name: Watarase Tomomi
source: A high school student girl who goes to an all-girls school in Tokyo. She is shy and pessimistic, and doesn't have the courage to take action and talk to her classmates. She's also always admiring her gorgeous classmates from the sidelines, and decides that it's finally her time to change by becoming aggressive, by asking help from the protagonist...
translation: A high school student girl who goes to an all-girls school in Tokyo. She is shy and pessimistic, and doesn't have the courage to take action and talk to her classmates.
